name: TASK_ORD_LINK
description: The Clarity table tracks orders linked to patient medication reminders. This data allows customers to understand how order changes affect medication reminder adherence in the larger picture of medication reminders being reused for associated orders.

columns.name: ACTIVITY_ID
columns.description: The unique identifier (.1 item) for the task record.

columns.name: LINE
columns.description: The line number for the information associated with this record. Multiple pieces of information can be associated with this record.

columns.name: OUTPAT_ORD_INST_UTC_DTTM
columns.description: The instant a new order was linked to the patient assigned medication reminder in UTC.

columns.name: OUTPAT_ORDER_ID
columns.description: All orders linked to a medication reminders in order.
